def terminal_returns(flow, value):
    match value:
        case 1:
            return
        case _:
            return
    flow.metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "dead-return"

def terminal_raise(flow, value):
    match value:
        case 1:
            return
        case _:
            raise RuntimeError
    flow.metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "dead-raise"

def unmatched_path(flow, value):
    match value:
        case 1:
            return
    flow.metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "unmatched"

def guarded_wildcard(flow, value, condition):
    match value:
        case _ if condition:
            return
    flow.metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "guarded"

def case_fallthrough(flow, value):
    match value:
        case 1:
            return
        case _:
            pass
    flow.metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "case-fallthrough"

def suppressible_raise(flow, value):
    meta = flow.metadata
    with context():
        match value:
            case 1:
                return
            case _:
                raise RuntimeError
    meta["sandbox_run_id"] = "suppressed"
